subject: english-language
title: Headlines and Hooks
welcome_lead: Newspapers and websites fight for your click.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on headlines, captions and media hooks.
final_note: You can now analyse a headline for technique and intent.

walkthroughs.body_html: Headlines often use puns or alliteration: 'Crumbs! Local Baker Crowned'. Short, punchy, memorable.
Clickbait overstates or hides the point ('You'll never believe what happened!'). Effective but trust-corroding.
Captions sit under images; pull quotes blow up a striking line to draw the eye into the article.
